normalisation.note: Applied to every candidate row label and every alias before comparison. Folding is what allows a single Chinese alias to cover both scripts.
pipeline: Traditional to Simplified fold (OpenCC t2s) applied to BOTH sides of the comparison, so 銷售成本 and 销售成本 collapse to one key.
Full-width to half-width punctuation; map ╱ ／ ⁄ to /; map （） to (); map 、 to , .
Strip footnote and note markers: trailing digits in parentheses, superscripts, '(note 12)', '附註12', '(附注12)'.
Strip trailing colons and dashes used to introduce sub-captions ('Share of profits and losses of:').
Strip inline unit and currency annotations: "RMB'000", '人民幣千元', '(unaudited)', '（未經審核）'.
Collapse internal whitespace to a single space; strip zero-width characters and soft hyphens.
Join a wrapped caption to its continuation line before matching, then also retain the bare fragment as a fallback candidate.
normalisation.wrapped_caption_rule: On a bilingual HKEX statement a caption printed across two physical lines ('TOTAL COMPREHENSIVE' / '年內全面虧損總額' / 'LOSS FOR THE YEAR') must be reassembled from the value row upward before matching. Match the reassembled string first; only if that fails may the bare fragment be used, and then only against concepts whose include criteria explicitly admit the fragment.

binding.note: Precedence is section-first. A concept can only claim a row printed inside one of its section_scope values.
order: 1. Resolve the statement (balance_sheet / profit_and_loss / cash_flow) from the page or table caption.

2. Resolve the printed section from the nearest preceding section header. If no header is resolvable, the row is unbound: route to review, never guess a section. (A row WITH a resolved section that no concept claims is not unbound — it is swept into that section's residual; see unbound_row_policy.)
3. Restrict the candidate concept set to concepts whose section_scope contains the resolved section.
4. Rule tier: exact normalised alias, then regex_hints, in descending match_priority. Any exclude_hints hit is a hard veto, not a score penalty.
5. Semantic tier over the restricted set only, using definition + include + exclude. Never over the full ontology.
6. Tie between concepts listed in each other's confusable_with: resolve with section_disambiguation; if still tied, emit both as candidates and route to review. Never pick by declaration order.
7. Residual sweep (see residual_framework) runs last, over rows no dedicated concept claimed.
8. Reconcile the section against its reported subtotal.
binding.unbound_row_policy: Route an unclaimed face value only to the residual for its resolved printed section. Never borrow a neighbouring concept or cross a section. After all mapping and gap-closing opportunities, the engine-level face_mapping_contract gives any remaining face value a unique engine_unclassified_face key outside the ontology/template namespaces. This keeps the row stored and reviewable without feeding it into an unrelated calculation. Verified non-additive aggregates replaced by mapped components remain evidence-only.
binding.match_priority: Integer 0-99, higher evaluated first. Long specific captions rank above short generic ones so 'Total assets less current liabilities' cannot be pre-empted by 'Total current liabilities' on token overlap. Residuals are 0 and unreachable by matching.

scope_selection.note: Absent from v1 and a common cause of silent mis-loads on HKEX filings.

entity_scope.rule: Where a statement prints Group and Company columns side by side, take the Group (consolidated) column. Record entity_scope on every fact. Never mix columns within one statement.
company_only_markers: Presence of bs_non_current_assets__investments_in_subsidiaries on the face is strong evidence the column is company-only, since consolidation eliminates it.

period_selection.rule: Identify the current period from the column heading date, not from column position; HKEX filings are not consistently current-first. Load comparatives only into the comparative period slot.
period_selection.restatement_rule: Where a comparative column is labelled restated / 重列 / 經重列, load it as the comparative and set restated: true. Do not overwrite a previously loaded original comparative; keep both with a restatement flag.

units_and_currency.rule: Resolve currency and scale from the statement header, not the cover page, and re-resolve per statement. Persist unit on every fact; never normalise scale silently.
units_and_currency.conflict: If header scale and a printed subtotal are inconsistent by a factor of 1,000, trust neither: route the statement to review.

scope_selection.column_guard: Every fact carries the resolved (entity_scope, period, currency, unit). Two facts for the same canonical_key that differ on any of these are distinct facts, not duplicates.

sign_convention.stored_value: The reported value after paren-to-negative conversion.
sign_convention.expenses_and_outflows: Stored NEGATIVE. This is required by the template: pl_gross_profit = sum(revenue, cost_of_goods_sold) and pl_profit_before_exceptional_items_and_tax = sum(total_income, total_operating_cost, total_non_operating_expense) only hold if expense concepts carry a negative sign.
sign_convention.unsigned_source: Where a filing prints expenses as unsigned positives in a by-nature list, negate on load and set sign_normalised: true on the fact so the transformation is auditable.
sign_convention.either: Subtotals, working-capital movements, fair-value changes, share of results, OCI and net cash flows are sign-indeterminate. Retain the reported sign; never coerce.
sign_convention.validation: A concept whose sign_convention is positive_expected or negative_expected but whose loaded value carries the opposite sign is a review trigger, not an auto-correction.

global_rules.face_only_default: Concepts default to face_only: true. Notes are evidence for a face amount, never an independent source of one, unless note_use is decomposition_allowed.
global_rules.duplicate_fact_rule: The same economic fact on the face and in a note is one fact with multiple evidence references, not two additive values. This also applies to two face captions that report the same amount (see equivalence blocks).
parent_child_allocation: Never load a gross parent and its separately mapped children additively.
Residual = reported parent minus confirmed included children.
Subtract only on explicit inclusion wording, hierarchy, reconciliation or arithmetic support.
If containment is uncertain, retain the parent as evidence and route to review.
global_rules.no_fabricated_split: Never invent a decomposition. Where only a combined figure is reported, load the combined concept and leave the children empty. The one exception is a concept declaring sole_component_of: assigning a whole undifferentiated figure to a single child divides nothing, and it is refused as soon as any sibling child is evidenced on the face or in the subtotal's own note.
global_rules.totals_policy: Compute totals from mutually exclusive concept outputs. Use reported totals only for validation, never as an input to the components.

residual_framework.note: One definition governing the 11 output-template subsection residuals. Each uses an existing template line; no template row is added.

sweep.runs: after all dedicated concepts in the section have been resolved, before section reconciliation
sweep.candidate_set: every printed value row on the FACE of the statement whose resolved section equals the residual's single section_scope value
eligibility: The row printed a value for the selected entity_scope, period, currency and unit.
No dedicated concept whose section_scope contains this section claimed the row.

The row is not a section subtotal, statement total, section header, attribution caption, per-share figure, narrative row, note-reference-only row, truncated caption, an of which breakdown of the row above it (其中：/ of which) or a sub-enumerated component of it (（一）… / 1.… beneath 五、净利润) — each of those amounts is already inside the row above, so sweeping it counts the same money twice.
The row was printed INSIDE this section. A row printed in any other section is ineligible however similar its wording — there is no cross-section rescue.

The row's sign agrees with the section's sign_convention, where the section states one. A row signed against its section is evidence the SECTION is wrong, not the amount, so it goes to review rather than into the bucket — a cost swept into income moves the income subtotal and every total below it.
sweep.plug_behaviour: forbidden — the residual is never computed as (reported subtotal − mapped children)
sweep.literal_others_caption: A row captioned 'Others' / '其他' is simply one unmapped face row and sweeps in as a single component. It gets no privileged treatment and no dedicated concept.

itemisation.rule: The residual's value is the arithmetic sum of its components. Original labels and signs are always retained; a swept row is never relabelled to 'Others'.

reconciliation.identity: reported_section_subtotal − Σ(dedicated concepts in section) − Σ(residual components) = 0
reconciliation.tolerance: one rounding unit per contributing row
reconciliation.on_failure: Emit an unallocated_gap fact carrying the difference and route the section to review. Never adjust the residual, and never adjust a dedicated concept, to close the gap.
reconciliation.sections_without_reported_subtotal: If the section prints no subtotal, the residual is still itemised but is flagged unreconciled and carries lower confidence.

review_triggers: any single component exceeds 2% of |reported section subtotal|
a component label scored at or above the semantic threshold against a dedicated concept but was vetoed by exclude_hints
residual sign is opposite to the section's sign_convention
the section reconciliation emitted an unallocated_gap
prohibitions: Never populated by alias, regex or embedding match.
Never carries a value with no itemised components.
Never absorbs a row a dedicated concept could have claimed but was not tested for — all dedicated concepts in the section must be evaluated first.
Never spans sections, statements, periods, entity scopes or units.

mappings.label: Land
mappings.definition: Freehold land the entity owns and holds for its own use, as a row of its own among the non-current assets of the balance sheet ('Land', 'Freehold land'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Fixed Assets, beside Buildings, Leasehold Improvements, Plant & Equipment, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment, Other Fixed Assets and Construction in Progress. Take the class at the amount the balance sheet carries it: net of depreciation where the face prints it net, as nearly every HKFRS and CAS balance sheet does; at cost only where the face itself prints the class at cost with the accumulated depreciation as a separate deduction row, which is then 'Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'. Not this line: land use rights and prepaid land premiums ('Land use rights', 'Prepaid land lease payments(LTP)'); leasehold land or land printed together with buildings ('Buildings'); land held as investment property ('Investment Property(Net)'); land held for property development or sale, which is inventory. A PRC entity holds no freehold land, so a CAS balance sheet has no such row. Where the balance sheet prints property, plant and equipment as one row, that row is 'Plant & Equipment' as printed and is not split into classes from its breakdown. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.
include: Amounts or disclosures explicitly reported for Land in Balance Sheet / bs_nca.
exclude: Do not substitute another section, period, entity scope, currency or unit; do not double count a parent and its children.
mappings.decomposition_rule: Decompose only from explicit face or note evidence; never fabricate a split.
mappings.section_disambiguation: Bind only to Balance Sheet / bs_nca.

mappings.label: Buildings
mappings.definition: Buildings held for the entity's own use — offices, factories, warehouses — including leasehold land and buildings and land and buildings where the balance sheet prints them together as a row of their own among the non-current assets ('Buildings', 'Land and buildings', 'Leasehold land and buildings'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Fixed Assets, beside Land, Leasehold Improvements, Plant & Equipment, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment, Other Fixed Assets and Construction in Progress. Take the class at the amount the balance sheet carries it: net of depreciation where the face prints it net, as nearly every HKFRS and CAS balance sheet does; at cost only where the face itself prints the class at cost with the accumulated depreciation as a separate deduction row, which is then 'Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'. Not this line: land use rights or a leasehold land interest printed as its own row ('Land use rights', 'Prepaid land lease payments(LTP)'); buildings held to earn rentals or for capital appreciation ('Investment Property(Net)'); properties under development or held for sale, which are inventory; buildings still under construction ('Construction in Progress'); right-of-use assets over leased property ('Other Fixed Assets'). On a CAS balance sheet buildings sit inside 固定资产, which is 'Net Fixed Assets' as printed. Where the balance sheet prints property, plant and equipment as one row, that row is 'Plant & Equipment' as printed and is not split into classes from its breakdown. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

mappings.definition: Improvements, fit-out and decoration the entity has made to premises it leases, and land improvements, carried as a class of fixed assets in a row of its own among the non-current assets of the balance sheet ('Leasehold improvements', 'Decoration', 'Land improvements'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Fixed Assets, beside Land, Buildings, Plant & Equipment, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment, Other Fixed Assets and Construction in Progress. Take the class at the amount the balance sheet carries it: net of depreciation where the face prints it net, as nearly every HKFRS and CAS balance sheet does; at cost only where the face itself prints the class at cost with the accumulated depreciation as a separate deduction row, which is then 'Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'. Not this line: the CAS row 长期待摊费用 (long-term prepaid expenses, which often holds renovation costs), which is 'Other Non-Current Assets' as printed; buildings ('Buildings'); right-of-use assets ('Other Fixed Assets'). Where the balance sheet prints property, plant and equipment as one row, that row is 'Plant & Equipment' as printed and is not split into classes from its breakdown. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

mappings.definition: Plant, machinery and equipment held for use in production, supply or administration — machinery, computer and office equipment — and, where the balance sheet prints property, plant and equipment as a single row among the non-current assets, that whole row as printed ('Property, plant and equipment', 'Property and equipment', 物业、厂房及设备, 物业及设备). That single row is cited as it stands and not split into Land, Buildings, Furniture & Fixtures or the other classes from its breakdown; those lines then answer empty. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Fixed Assets, beside Land, Buildings, Leasehold Improvements, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment, Other Fixed Assets and Construction in Progress. Take the class at the amount the balance sheet carries it: net of depreciation where the face prints it net, as nearly every HKFRS and CAS balance sheet does; at cost only where the face itself prints the class at cost with the accumulated depreciation as a separate deduction row, which is then 'Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'. Not this line: right-of-use assets, oil and gas assets and productive biological assets ('Other Fixed Assets'), construction in progress printed as its own row ('Construction in Progress'), investment properties ('Investment Property(Net)'). On a CAS balance sheet the row 固定资产 is 'Net Fixed Assets' as printed, not this line. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

mappings.definition: Fixed assets other than the named classes, as rows printed among the non-current assets of the balance sheet: right-of-use assets (使用权资产, 'Right-of-use assets'), oil and gas assets (油气资产), productive biological assets (生产性生物资产), assets held under finance leases, and fixed assets in the course of disposal (固定资产清理) where printed as their own row. Where the balance sheet prints more than one of these rows, cite each; the line is their total. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Fixed Assets, beside Land, Buildings, Leasehold Improvements, Plant & Equipment, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment and Construction in Progress. Take the class at the amount the balance sheet carries it: net of depreciation where the face prints it net, as nearly every HKFRS and CAS balance sheet does; at cost only where the face itself prints the class at cost with the accumulated depreciation as a separate deduction row, which is then 'Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'. Not this line: the single HKFRS row 'Property, plant and equipment' ('Plant & Equipment'); the CAS row 固定资产 ('Net Fixed Assets'); construction in progress ('Construction in Progress'); investment properties ('Investment Property(Net)'); land use rights printed as their own row ('Land use rights'). A right-of-use asset inside a property, plant and equipment row is not split out of it. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

mappings.label: Construction in Progress
mappings.definition: Fixed assets still being built or installed and not yet ready for use, as a row printed among the non-current assets of the balance sheet: 在建工程 on a CAS balance sheet as printed (which also carries 工程物资, construction materials, where the face combines them), and 'Construction in progress' where an HKFRS balance sheet prints it apart from property, plant and equipment. Where construction in progress is only part of a 'Property, plant and equipment' row, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. mappings.label: Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)
mappings.definition: The accumulated depreciation and accumulated impairment losses on the fixed assets this template counts in Gross Fixed Assets, where the balance sheet itself prints them as a deduction row beneath fixed assets carried at cost ('Less: accumulated depreciation', 'Accumulated depreciation and impairment'). Net Fixed Assets is Gross Fixed Assets plus this line, so the template carries it as a negative figure, a deduction. Where the balance sheet prints its fixed assets net — every CAS balance sheet, and nearly every HKFRS one — the fixed asset lines already carry net amounts: answer with an empty sources list, and do not take the accumulated depreciation from the breakdown of a net row, which would deduct it a second time. Not this line: accumulated amortisation of intangible assets ('Accum Intgbl Assets Amort(-)') or of goodwill ('Accum Goodwill Amortized(-)'); the depreciation charge for the year.

mappings.label: Net Fixed Assets
mappings.definition: Fixed assets net of accumulated depreciation and impairment, reported in the non-current assets section of the balance sheet. It covers every class this template counts in Gross Fixed Assets: property, plant and equipment, other fixed assets (which include right-of-use assets, oil and gas assets and productive biological assets) and construction in progress. A CAS balance sheet prints these as separate net rows with no total over them: 固定资产, 在建工程 and 使用权资产, and 油气资产 or 生产性生物资产 where printed. Cite each of those rows as a component; the line is their sum. An HKFRS balance sheet prints 'Property, plant and equipment' and 'Right-of-use assets' (with construction in progress inside the first, or as its own row): cite each. Where the filing prints a single net total over them, cite that total. Investment properties and intangible assets are not fixed assets here. The line equals Gross Fixed Assets plus Accum Deprec & Impairment(-), the reported contra-asset.

mappings.label: Goodwill
mappings.definition: Goodwill arising on business combinations, as the balance sheet prints it among the non-current assets (商誉, 'Goodwill'), carried net of accumulated impairment as printed. mappings.label: Allow for Doubtful Accounts(-)
mappings.definition: The loss allowance on trade receivables — the provision for impairment, expected credit losses or bad and doubtful debts held against them at the end of the period — which takes trade receivables from their gross amount to their net carrying amount. On a CAS filing it is the 合计 of the 坏账准备 column in the disclosed breakdown of 应收账款; on an HKFRS filing it is the loss or impairment allowance that the filing's breakdown of trade receivables deducts ('Less: loss allowance', 'Allowance for credit losses', 'Provision for impairment of trade receivables'). Where the balance sheet itself prints the allowance as a row of its own beneath the gross trade receivables, it is that row. Cite the figure as printed, which is normally unsigned: the template carries this line as a negative figure, a deduction, and this template's rollup adds it to 'Trade Receivables(Gross)' to make Net Trade Receivables. It is the balance at the end of the period, not a movement: not the impairment loss of the year ('Bad Debt Expense'), and not the amounts provided, reversed or written off in the year. Not this line: the allowance on other receivables, on bills receivable or receivables financing, on contract assets or on long-term receivables. mappings.label: LTD Bank
mappings.definition: Long-term bank borrowings: loans from banks repayable after more than one year — term, syndicated and mortgage loans, secured and unsecured together — reported in the non-current liabilities section of the balance sheet. On a CAS statement this line is 长期借款 as printed, whatever kinds of loan its breakdown lists (信用借款, 保证借款, 抵押借款, 质押借款). On an HKFRS statement it is the non-current 'Bank borrowings', 'Bank loans', 'Interest-bearing bank borrowings' or 'Long-term borrowings' row. The line is the row as printed, and nothing is taken off it. Where one non-current row prints bank and other loans together ('Interest-bearing bank and other borrowings', 'Bank and other loans'), or long-term borrowings that include debentures or notes, cite that row as printed: the whole row is this line, the other loans and the bonds in it included, and 'LTD Other' and the other debt lines take only rows of their own printed beside it, never a part split out of this row. The part due within one year is 'CPLTD Bank'. Not this line: bonds, guaranteed or senior notes, debentures and other non-bank loans printed as rows of their own ('LTD Other'); convertible, subordinated or perpetual instruments ('LTD Convertible', 'LTD Subordinated', 'Perpetual Bond'); repurchase agreements ('Repo(LTP)'); lease liabilities ('Lease liabilities(LTP)'); finance lease payables ('Finance Leases(LTP)'); entrusted loans (the 'Entrusted loan payables' lines); amounts due to related parties, directors, shareholders or subsidiaries (the 'Due to' lines). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

mappings.definition: Current amounts the company owes to related parties other than for goods and services bought — to the parent group, fellow subsidiaries, associates, joint ventures and other related companies — such as non-trade payables, advances, current accounts, and interest and dividends payable to them. The figure comes first from the related-party disclosure of balances: on a CAS filing the counterparty rows listed under the 其他应付款 group of its table of amounts payable to related parties (应付项目); on an HKFRS filing the balances under a 'Due to related parties' heading. Where that disclosure gives none, it is the current-liabilities row the balance sheet prints as 'Due to related parties' or 'Amounts due to related companies' (應付關聯方款項). This template derives the figure from those parts; do not assemble it yourself. Not this line: trade payables to related parties ('Trade payables- related parties'); a single row of trade AND other payables to related parties ('Trade and other payables- related parties'); borrowings and entrusted loans from related parties; contract liabilities; rows the balance sheet prints on their own as due to directors, subsidiaries, shareholders or holding companies, or non-controlling interests ('Due to directors(CP)', 'Due to subsidiaries(CP)', 'Due to S'holder(CP)', 'Due to MI(CP)'); the non-current balance ('Due to Related Parties(LTP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

mappings.definition: Consideration the company has received, or is owed, from customers before it has transferred the goods, services or property it relates to, held as a current liability: on a CAS balance sheet 合同负债 and 预收款项 as printed; on an HKFRS statement 'Contract liabilities' (合約負債, 合同負債), 'Receipts in advance', 'Advances from customers' (预收客户款项), 'Deposits from customers', 'Customer deposits', 'Trade deposits received', 'Sales deposits received' and deposits received on pre-sale of properties (已收預售款項), and 'Amounts due to customers for contract work'. mappings.label: Billings in Excess of Costs
mappings.definition: Progress billings on construction and other long-term contracts that exceed the contract costs incurred plus recognised profits (less recognised losses), held as a current liability, where the balance sheet prints that excess as a row of its own under that name: 'Billings in excess of costs', 'Billings in excess of costs and estimated earnings on uncompleted contracts', 'Excess of progress billings over contract costs'. mappings.label: Trade and other payables(CP)
mappings.definition: Current payables that the balance sheet prints in ONE row together with trade payables, and the other-payables and accruals rows this template files here: HKFRS 'Trade and other payables' (應付賬款及其他應付款項, 貿易及其他應付款項), 'Creditors, other payables and accruals', 'Trade payables, other payables and accruals' (貿易應付款、其他應付款及應計費用), 'Accounts payable and accrued liabilities', and 'Other payables and accruals' (其他應付款項及應計費用), 'Other payables' (其他應付款項) or 'Accruals' (應計費用) printed on their own. Read the printed row and cite it as printed. Where the filing's breakdown of a combined row prints the trade payables inside it and the balance sheet prints no trade payables row of its own, those trade payables are 'Trade Payables(CP)': the template takes that figure out of the printed combined row, so this line is the combined row less the trade payables — a remainder the template computes and flags as one, not a figure the filing prints. Do not take the trade payables out yourself. Where trade payables are printed in a row of their own, that row is 'Trade Payables(CP)', and related-party balances printed apart are 'Trade and other payables- related parties'. Not this line: on a CAS balance sheet 其他应付款, which this template files in 'Other Current Liabilities'; a trade payables or trade and bills payables row alone (应付账款, 'Trade payables', 'Trade and bills payables': 'Trade Payables(CP)'); bills payable ('Notes Payable(CP)'); contract liabilities and receipts in advance ('Customer Advances(CP)'); amounts due to related parties printed on their own ('Due to Related Parties(CP)'); the non-current balance ('Trade and other payables(LTP)'). mappings.label: Net Profit/(Loss)
mappings.definition: The profit or loss the indirect-method operating section starts from: the first row of the operating activities section of the cash flow statement, before any adjustment. On an HKFRS statement this is usually the profit or loss before tax ('Profit before tax', 'Loss before taxation', 'Profit/(loss) before tax', 除稅前溢利 / 除稅前虧損); some statements start from the profit for the year after tax ('Profit for the year', 年內溢利), and either is this line as printed. On a CAS filing it is the first row of the reconciliation of net profit to operating cash flow that a CAS cash flow statement prints as its supplement (现金流量表补充资料, 将净利润调节为经营活动现金流量): 净利润, the net profit including the non-controlling interests' share. Take the figure for the whole group as the statement prints it, not the profit attributable to owners of the parent. Not this line: the income tax added back below a profit-after-tax starting row ('Income Tax Expense'); the non-controlling interests' share added back where the reconciliation starts from the owners' profit ('Minority Interests(CF)'); the operating profit before working capital changes, a subtotal printed further down. It is a printed row; where the section prints no starting profit, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

mappings.label: Other After Tax (Income)/Expense
mappings.definition: An item stated after tax that the indirect-method operating section prints as its own row beside the starting profit, adjusting it before the non-cash adjustments — for example the result of discontinued operations, net of tax, where the reconciliation starts from the profit of continuing operations and brings the discontinued result in on a separate row. It is not the starting profit itself ('Net Profit/(Loss)'), not the income tax added back ('Income Tax Expense'), not the non-controlling interests' share ('Minority Interests(CF)'), and not any pre-tax adjustment for non-cash items (depreciation, impairment, gains and losses on disposal, fair-value changes), each of which has its own line or falls to 'Other Non-Cash Adjs(Oper)'. Most HKFRS and CAS statements print no such row: answer with an empty sources list unless the operating section prints one. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

mappings.label: Minority Interests(CF)
mappings.definition: The non-controlling (minority) interests' share of profit or loss, where the indirect-method operating section prints it as its own row adding it back to a starting profit that is attributable to owners of the parent only (少数股东损益, 'Non-controlling interests', 'Minority interests'). Where the reconciliation starts from the profit of the whole group — profit before tax on an HKFRS statement, 净利润 on a CAS reconciliation — the minority share is already inside the starting row and this line is empty. Not this line: dividends paid to non-controlling shareholders ('Dvds Paid(Minority S'holders)'); capital contributed by them ('Net Proceeds Issuance of Capital'); the starting profit ('Net Profit/(Loss)'). It is a printed row; where the section prints none, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

mappings.label: Income Tax Expense
mappings.definition: The income tax expense added back in the indirect-method operating section, where the reconciliation starts from the profit for the year after tax: a row such as 'Income tax expense', 'Taxation' or 'Tax expense' (所得稅開支, 税项开支, 所得税费用) printed among the adjustments to that profit. It is the charge the income statement recognised, current and deferred together, not the tax paid in cash. Where the reconciliation starts from the profit before tax — usual on an HKFRS statement — there is no tax add-back and this line is empty; a CAS reconciliation starts from 净利润 and adjusts tax only through the deferred tax rows ('Chg in Deferred Taxes'). Not this line: income taxes paid in cash ('Income Taxes Paid(Indirect)'); the change in deferred tax assets and liabilities ('Chg in Deferred Taxes'); the change in tax payable ('Chg in Taxes Payable'). It is a printed row; where the section prints none, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

mappings.label: Depreciation
mappings.definition: Depreciation added back to profit in the indirect-method operating section: depreciation of property, plant and equipment, of right-of-use assets and of investment properties carried at cost, depletion of oil and gas assets, and the amortisation of land use rights and leasehold land — 'Depreciation', 'Depreciation of property, plant and equipment', 'Depreciation of right-of-use assets' (物業、廠房及設備折舊, 使用權資產折舊). On a CAS filing it is the rows of the reconciliation of net profit to operating cash flow that a CAS cash flow statement prints as its supplement (现金流量表补充资料, 将净利润调节为经营活动现金流量) for 固定资产折旧、油气资产折耗、生产性生物资产折旧 and 使用权资产折旧, together. Where the filing prints depreciation in several rows (by class of asset), this line is their total; where it prints one combined row for depreciation and amortisation ('Depreciation and amortisation', 'Depreciation, depletion and amortisation', 折旧及摊销) or depreciation and impairment, that row is this line as printed and is not split. Not this line: amortisation of other intangible assets and of long-term prepaid expenses, and impairment losses, where printed on rows of their own ('Amortization & Asset Impairment'); the gain or loss on disposal of fixed assets ('Cash Flow Disp Fixed Assets'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

mappings.label: Amortization & Asset Impairment
mappings.definition: Amortisation of intangible assets and the impairment of assets added back to profit in the indirect-method operating section: amortisation of other intangible assets and of long-term deferred or prepaid expenses, impairment losses (and reversals, as negative figures) on property, plant and equipment, intangible assets, goodwill and other assets, write-downs of inventories, and expected credit losses on receivables — rows such as 'Amortisation of intangible assets', 'Impairment of property, plant and equipment', 'Impairment of trade receivables, net', 'Expected credit loss'. On a CAS filing it is the rows of the reconciliation of net profit to operating cash flow that a CAS cash flow statement prints as its supplement (现金流量表补充资料, 将净利润调节为经营活动现金流量) for 信用减值损失, 资产减值损失 (or 资产减值准备), 无形资产摊销 and 长期待摊费用摊销, together. Where the filing prints these in several rows this line is their total. Not this line: depreciation of property, plant and equipment and right-of-use assets, or a combined depreciation and amortisation row ('Depreciation'); fair-value changes on investment properties or financial assets, which are not impairment ('Other Non-Cash Adjs(Oper)'); gains and losses on disposal ('Cash Flow Disp Fixed Assets', 'Cash Flow Disp Financial Assets'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

mappings.label: Assoc Profit Share(Net of Dvds)
mappings.definition: The share of profits or losses of associates and joint ventures taken out of profit in the indirect-method operating section, as the statement prints it among the adjustments: 'Share of profits and losses of associates', 'Share of profits and losses of joint ventures', 'Share of results of associates' (應佔聯營公司損益, 應佔合營公司業績), or rows captioned 'Associates' and 'Joint ventures' (聯營公司, 合營公司) under a 'Share of profits and losses of' subheading. Where the filing prints associates and joint ventures on separate rows this line is their total, and where it prints the share net of the dividends received from those entities, that net row is this line. Not this line: dividends received from associates and joint ventures printed on their own row ('Dividends Received(Oper)' in the operating section, 'Dividends Received(Invest)' in investing); gains or losses on disposing of an associate or joint venture, and their impairment (adjustments that fall to 'Other Non-Cash Adjs(Oper)' unless a dedicated line claims them). A CAS reconciliation's 投资损失 row covers all investment income and is not this line. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

mappings.definition: The (increase)/decrease in trade receivables: a movement in working capital printed in the indirect-method operating section, between the adjusted profit and 'Cash generated from operations' — 'Decrease in trade receivables', 'Increase in trade receivables', '(Increase)/decrease in debtors', and the change in bills receivable and receivables financing. mappings.label: Dividends Paid(Fin)

Nothing is taken off it: an 'of which' row printed under the combined row for dividends paid by subsidiaries to non-controlling shareholders (其中：子公司支付给少数股东的股利、利润) is inside that figure and stays there, and no other line takes it. Where the statement prints no dividends paid row, this line has no figure: it is never made up from the non-controlling dividends. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows from Finance Activities.

mappings.definition: The cash and cash equivalents at the beginning of the period, as the cash flow statement prints it below the net increase or decrease in cash: 'Cash and cash equivalents at beginning of year', 'Cash and cash equivalents at the beginning of the year' (年初現金及現金等價物). On a CAS statement it is 加：期初现金及现金等价物余额, as printed. It is the statement's own opening figure, which can differ from the cash and bank balances of the balance sheet (time deposits over three months, restricted or pledged cash, bank overdrafts). Not this line: the cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period ('End of Period-Cash & Cash Equiv'); the rows of the analysis of cash and cash equivalents balances printed under the statement; the balance sheet's cash line. It is a printed row; where the statement prints no opening cash figure, answer with an empty sources list.

mappings.label: End of Period-Cash & Cash Equiv
mappings.definition: The cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period, as the cash flow statement prints it at its foot, after the net cash flows of the three activities and the effect of exchange rate changes: 'Cash and cash equivalents at end of year', 'Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the reporting period' (年末現金及現金等價物); on a CAS statement 六、期末现金及现金等价物余额, as printed. It closes the whole statement and is not part of the financing activities section. It is the statement's own closing figure, which can differ from the cash and bank balances of the balance sheet (time deposits over three months, restricted or pledged cash, bank overdrafts). Read the printed row. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with the opening cash plus the year's net cash flows and the exchange difference: that arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a closing figure the statement prints is the more authoritative number. What the printed figure and that arithmetic leave between them is 'Unexplained Adjustment to Cash'. Not this line: the cash and cash equivalents at the beginning of the period ('Beg of Period-Cash & Cash Equiv'); the rows of the analysis of balances of cash and cash equivalents printed under the statement; the balance sheet's cash line ('Cash in Hand and at Banks'). Where the statement prints no closing cash figure, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

mappings.label: Unexplained Adjustment to Cash
mappings.definition: The part of the year's movement in cash and cash equivalents that the cash flow statement leaves unexplained: what remains between the closing cash and cash equivalents the statement prints and the opening cash and cash equivalents together with the net cash flows from operating, investing and financing activities and the net foreign exchange difference. It belongs to the foot of the statement, beside the opening and closing cash, and is not part of the financing activities section. Neither HKFRS nor CAS prints such a row — a statement that reconciles leaves nothing here — and the figure is this template's own check, whose arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup. Do not cite a row for it and do not compute it yourself: answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup. Not this line: the effect of exchange rate changes on cash ('Net Foreign Exchange Difference'); the net increase or decrease in cash and cash equivalents; other financing cash flows ('Other Financing Cash Flows').
include: Amounts or disclosures explicitly reported for Unexplained Adjustment to Cash in Cash Flow / cf_financing.
exclude: Do not substitute another section, period, entity scope, currency or unit; do not double count a parent and its children.
mappings.decomposition_rule: Use only dependencies stated in the formula; never fabricate missing components.
